content.text: Jimmy Kerr just hit an oppo bomb in gcl game. First pitch
Liked “Jimmy Kerr just hit an oppo bomb in gcl game. First pitch”
I’m getting roasted for having Al’s back
I screenshotted all the receipts on twitter so I can laugh at all these dumbasses when we’ve rebuilt the org and are winning in a couple years

It’s not even about having his back, it’s just the practical thing that always made the most sense. People are mad because they can’t SEE the improvements. It’s like renovating a house and the biggest expenses are doing foundation repair, sealing the basement, and patching a roof. It’s all shit you can’t see but it’s the most important stuff that has to be done

But trust me, if you could see the everyday, day-to-day changes in player development and scouting...it’s almost crazy. The club has improved 10 years worth in the last two. The shit we have at our disposal now, we didn’t have in our dreams 5 years ago. That’s all Chris Illitch and Al. But people in Michigan are mad because they can’t see it.
